title: Tag on the 14 original Tag courses
summary: Games > Tag and Pause > Play Tag now host a room on the original TG courses (E01-E08_TG and F01-F06_TG) using the original tagball model and the recovered rules. PR #390 is open and queued to merge through auto-merge.
details: The 14 TG courses are already on the live content host and all 14 hashes were verified. Recovered rules: 25% chance the ball is knocked loose when a trick starts, the carrier has about 34% less top speed, a boundary throw-in near the heightfield edge (stadiums use only the edge), ground respawn from 18 level rays, ties broken by rider slot, and a 2 to 20 minute limit chosen in Games Prep. Also fixed a room opened from a link not moving to the Tag course.
Verification (host Chromium): the multiplayer_tag and new games_tag browser tests pass, plus an all-course sweep. Not yet a verified public release.
limitation: Guest tricks do not knock the ball loose; riders share one start; the ball only tests terrain; no ball spin.
